meta.title: Upload your prompts
meta.description: Post the prompt you refined so other developers can find it, preview it and drop it into their repo. Sign in, fill in the form and it gets its own page.

hero.title: You already wrote something other developers would love.
hero.lead: That .md file you tuned over dozens of sessions, the Cursor rule your whole team relies on, the agent playbook that finally just works: it can help a lot of people out there! Post it here and share it with the community.

listing.title: Test it, then show it
listing.lead: Run your file in a real project and make sure it does what it promises. Then take screenshots of what it produced: the form below needs at least one, and they are what convinces other developers to use it.

steps.title: From your file to a live listing

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.text: Create a free account, or sign in if you already have one.

send.title: Fill in the form and send it
send.text: Tell us what your prompt does and who it’s for, add your screenshots and the .md file, and send it.

feedback.title: Get feedback from our team
feedback.text: We get in touch right away and give you live feedback through our custom, streamlined review interface, so your prompt gets sharp and ready to post.

testing.title: Wait while we test it
testing.text: We thoroughly test your prompt across different agents and models, so the community gets the results it expects.

live.title: Go live
live.text: You get a notification when your prompt is live. Then watch the community use it, rate it and build with it!

form.title: Post your prompt
form.lead: Not sure it’s good enough? Post it anyway. If it made your own work easier, it will make someone else’s easier too.

signedOut.text: Sign in to post a prompt. It takes a minute and it’s free.

kind.label: Type
kind.hint: What is it: a prompt you copy, a skill the agent loads, or an agent (subagent) it hands work to?

title.label: Title
title.hint: What the prompt is, in a few words (shown as the page heading).

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.hint: Appealing sentence that describes the main result that developers will get.

summary.label: Summary
summary.hint: What your prompt is about, in a few sentences: a slightly more technical version of the tagline.

meantFor.label: Meant for
meantFor.hint: The technologies it suits, one per line (e.g. Python, Next.js, Any frontend framework).

highlights.label: Highlights
highlights.hint: A list of the key things your prompt does, up to {max} items.

usageSteps.label: Suggested use
usageSteps.hint: Things to keep in mind before using it, up to {max} items. Wrap file names in `backticks`.

outputExamples.label: Screenshots of the output
outputExamples.hint: Show what the prompt produces: at least one image, up to {max}, PNG, JPEG or WebP, 2 MB each.

coauthors.label: Co-authors (optional)
coauthors.hint: People who worked on it with you. They can push new versions and join the review. Up to {max}; you can add more later from the review.
coauthors.tooShort: Type at least two characters of a username.
coauthors.found: {count, plural, one {# user found} other {# users found}}.
coauthors.error: The search didn't work. Try again in a moment.
coauthors.full: That's {max} co-authors, the most you can add here.

preview.caption: See how your prompt will look once posted, built from what you enter in the form.

form.submitted: Sent for review. You can see your uploads in your <profile>profile</profile>.
form.fixFields: Some fields need a change before posting. They’re marked below.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again to post your prompt.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, quote this code: {requestId}.
errors.notConfigured: Posting isn’t available yet. Please try again later.
errors.imageUpload: Couldn’t upload the images. Check your connection and try again.

form.coauthorsNotAdded: These co-authors couldn't be added: {usernames}. You can add them from the review.

banner.live: Preview: this listing isn’t posted yet. It follows your form as you type; blank spaces are the parts you haven’t filled in.
banner.closed: The form’s tab was closed, so this preview stopped updating. Open the form again to keep editing.

noForm.title: No form to preview
noForm.text: Open the posting form in another tab of this browser and use “Preview listing”. This page then shows your listing as you fill it in.

validation.tooFewItems: Add at least {min, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}.
validation.fileType: Choose a Markdown file ending in .md.
validation.fileTooLarge: Choose a file up to 200 KB.
validation.fileEmpty: The file is empty. Choose the file with your prompt.
validation.imageType: Use PNG, JPEG or WebP images of up to 2 MB, in your own account.
validation.imageTooLarge: Each image can be up to 2 MB.
validation.coauthorInvalid: Pick co-authors from the search results, each once.
validation.imagesRequired: Add at least one screenshot of what the prompt produced.
